newsitem.title: JAPAN: Honda Motor shares cruise higher in morning.
newsitem.headline: Honda Motor shares cruise higher in morning.

text.p: Buying of shares in Honda Motor Co Ltd picked up on Wednesday morning, inflating the trade volume to nearly two million shares, the seventh-most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.
As of 0100 GMT, the shares were up 50 yen at 3,320 yen.
"It seems the share price is reaching the end of the adjustment phase it entered after surging to new record highs recently," a broker at a "Big Four" brokerage said.
"Dealers and probably some institutional investors are purchasing the shares," he added.
